item: R786 AI uninstall never removes the data folder
summary: Uninstall sized and removed the parent of HF_HUB_CACHE, so a hub cache inside the data folder took the whole data folder with it. Now hf_hub_cache() is the only HF folder removed, and an independent guard (run at listing and again on the resolved path before rmtree) refuses the data dir, anything holding it, other stores, keys, databases, backups, roots and home; fail closed.
